confidence_notes: Newcastle-specific cost-of-living aggregates anchor meals, coffee and beer. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain; local bar menu prices guide the cocktail, and the wine estimate uses local glass prices relative to draft beer. Accommodation is a broad July seasonal estimate; no live accommodation prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Newcastle-specific price aggregates. Accommodation uses a mid-sized coastal NSW regional-city baseline with a winter-season adjustment.
